locator.title: Как провести выходные семьей? Выбираю «Остров Мечты»!
locator.lead: Крытый парк развлечений «Остров Мечты». 1 билет = 49 аттракционов + 5 шоу
locator.caption: Самые искренние улыбки и яркие эмоции

nearest_text_before.text: Здесь можно с легкостью провести целый день. Территория парка разделена на 10 тематических зон, каждая - со своими уникальными декорациями, аттракционами и шоу с известными мультперсонажами.

image_reading: A red amusement-ride gondola is tilted high on its arc, carrying adults and children who are smiling and reacting excitedly.
The gondola and riders form the main diagonal; several riders already have raised arms, while the illuminated indoor fantasy architecture remains stationary behind them.
The gondola can continue its pendulum motion, with riders making a small shared weight shift while their joyful expressions remain visible.
analysis.article_context: The body image, captioned “Самые искренние улыбки и яркие эмоции,” illustrates the article’s promise of vivid, shared family fun at the indoor amusement park, immediately before the section about unlimited access to attractions and shows.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: A family attraction creates sincere shared joy and vivid memories, supporting the article’s invitation to spend an exciting day together at Dream Island.
structured_intent.primary_action: The amusement-ride gondola continues its pendulum downswing with the riders moving together.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The gondola is visibly lower on its arc, with the smiling group still together and reacting enthusiastically.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The riders remain visibly joyful, engaged, and together through the final frame.

models.scene_plan: Across five seconds, the gondola begins descending immediately and follows a smooth, moderate pendulum arc through most of the shot. Riders respond as one group with a gentle shared lean; existing raised arms remain raised without repeated gestures. The camera stays fixed to preserve the readable ride geometry. Near the end, the gondola reaches the lower portion of the arc while retaining slight forward momentum, and the riders remain visibly joyful.
models.positive_prompt: The gondola sweeps steadily downward along its pendulum arc as the riders lean with the motion, keeping their joyful expressions and raised arms. Fixed camera; by the final frame the gondola reaches the lower part of the arc, still moving smoothly with the group visibly delighted.

models.scene_plan: For four seconds, show one focused segment of the downswing at moderate speed and slightly smaller travel than the Wan plan. The gondola moves smoothly downward while the riders make one restrained collective lean, with no new gestures. Keep the camera fixed on the gondola. In the final frame it sits visibly lower along the arc, the riders unobscured and their excitement unchanged.
models.positive_prompt: The gondola glides down a short section of its pendulum arc while the riders lean together with the motion, still smiling with their raised arms held high. Fixed camera; it ends lower on the arc with the joyful group clearly visible.
